meta.unit: px; colours, glows and fonts as token names from the fixture crates/p4kx-gui/src/theme/fixtures/tokens.json
meta.textRule: text below 16 px uses fw-regular; fw-thin only for prose at 16 px or more

sidebar.collapse: decision D.52: below collapseWidth of the window the sidebar hides behind a rail of railWidth whose btn-xs btn-icon ghost button with a chevron shows it at minWidth and hides it again

workSurface.scroll: the room of a work tab below the tab bar is never smaller than minWidth by minHeight: a smaller window scrolls it in both directions, the tab bar stays; while a toolbar wraps its actions into a second row the room also keeps wrappedActionsHeight more, and the Entry list of the Browse tab keeps it more above the preview

container.row: ordinary tree row after the subfolders of its folder, name unchanged, no icon
container.opening: spinner 14, then Opening label in color-gray-2-text

quickFilter.radius: radius-sm on the group, the items share its outer corners

buttonDanger.usage: the confirming action in the foot of a modalDanger

hexRow.keyboard: Tab focuses the Text and Hex lines; arrows, Page Up, Page Down, Home and End scroll

progressBar.indeterminate: a step without a measure shows the empty track with a block of color-primary (color-gray-2 while cancelling) that sweeps from the start to the end of the track and begins again, once per spinner.periodMs

workTabs.position: top of the work surface, above the list panel

localizationTable.toolbar: listPanel toolbar: searchField with its eyebrow label, buttonGhost Copy key and Copy text right-aligned
localizationTable.rows: tableRow; a language column holds the text on one line, control and bidirectional characters as escapes in color-gray-2-text, cut after 1024 characters
localizationTable.header: tableHeader, one column for the key and one per language, labels in upper case, not sortable
localizationTable.selection: the selected row in controlSelectedBackground, the selected cell as the active row; a search that hides the selected row clears the selection
localizationTable.search: keys and the texts shown in the cells; a text shown as Missing is not matched
localizationTable.keyboard: Tab focuses the rows (scrollRegion of D.27, name Localisation rows); arrows scroll by one row or column step, Page Up, Page Down, Home and End scroll
localizationTable.footer: listFooter with the number of keys shown of all keys; the notes on files read lossily in a warning alert above the table

tagTree.toolbar: listPanel toolbar: searchField with its eyebrow label, buttonGhost Copy tag path and Copy GUID right-aligned
tagTree.header: tableHeader with the orange rule: Tag, GUID and Legacy ID, labels in upper case, not sortable
tagTree.rows: treeRow of the path tree (chevron, level rails, treeRowHover, active row as in the tree) with the name of the tag, then the GUID and the legacy ID in color-gray-2-text; a divider under each row
tagTree.table: TreeTable: one TableBuilder in a horizontal scroll area, the head and the rows share the columns, the tag column fills what the GUID and legacy ID columns leave and is never narrower than nameColumnMinWidth; the legacy ID is a number and right-aligned with its head
tagTree.search: the tag path ignoring case; matches are shown with the tags above them, whatever is expanded
tagTree.footer: listFooter with the number of tags, or the number shown of all tags while searching; a warningAlert above the header when the tree differs from what the TagDatabase lists

uiTab.rowHeightFrom: listPanel row 36 (rowHeight) + one more line of the row font 13.76
uiTab.toolbar: toolbar padding, rows of labelled segmented--sm groups: the eyebrow Source with Files and Ships, Size with Stage, 1024 px wide, 2048 px wide and 1920 x 1080, Background with Transparent, Movie colour, Black and White, Format with PNG and SVG, then a btn-cta Export...; the groups wrap into rows by their measured width and the toolbar is at most toolbarMaxShare of the window height and scrolls when its rows or one group alone are larger, so that the work area stays visible at 640 x 400; Size, Background and Format are remembered in the settings file
uiTab.lists: Files: a searchField with its eyebrow and a resizable list panel (sidebarMinWidth to sidebarMaxWidth) of GFx and SWF Entries, the file name in the row font bold when selected over its folder in color-gray-2-text; Ships: the same over the ships and vehicles, with a second list panel of the screens of the picked ship, the port or the own screen over the Entity and the size; listFooter with the number of rows or the number shown of all
uiTab.picture: the picture scaled to fit the room, never above pictureMaxScale, centred, with a hairline in color-gray-3 around it; the full path of the file or the record path of the canvas above it, wrapped and selectable; a transparent picture shows the panel through it
uiTab.detail: below the picture a resizable panel (previewPanel height) with two segments Contents and Left out, each with its count; Contents is a facts bar that wraps and a list of rows of the kind in color-gray-2-text and the details; Left out is, for a screen, the facts bar of widgets, shapes and texts, then the lines of what the renderer skipped, drew without an effect, left out or could not read, in the words of p4kx ui render, wrapped, up to reportMaxLines
uiTab.export: btn-cta Export... opens the save dialog of the system for the chosen format with the proposed name; the outcome stands below the toolbar in color-success-text, color-warning when elements were left out, color-danger-text on failure, with a btn-ghost btn-xs Close; the open Archive is never overwritten and a file inside a Star Citizen installation is refused with the message of the other exports
uiTab.messages: spinner with Drawing... while a picture is drawn; failure and stopped in a danger alert; archive changed in a warning alert; a picture above the texture limit of the device is not shown, with a note to export it

archivePicker.value: Channel · Build for a detected Channel, otherwise the Archive path
archivePicker.label: page-head__eyebrow, 11.2 / fw-bold / 0.15 em, color-gray-2-text
archivePicker.list: dropdown + dropdownItem: Channels with Build, Recent Archives, then Choose file

changeExtraction.position: list-panel toolbar, left of the shown count and Save report; wraps onto its own right-aligned toolbar row when the search field would get less than 260
changeExtraction.setup: the Extraction setup modal with the scope as body text and the narrowing Filter in color-gray-2-text

extractionSummary.keyboard: Tab focuses each list of the summary (failed Entries, not converted, Records not written, skipped, cancelled), named as its heading with the suffix rows; up and down arrows, Page Up, Page Down, Home and End scroll

dataForgeSummary.keyboard: Tab focuses the summary of the DataForge tab (name DataForge summary); up and down arrows, Page Up, Page Down, Home and End scroll

extractionAudio.row: radio row Sounds as: Ogg, WAV, WEM unchanged, 16 apart, radio to label 12; indented under the texture outputs; shown only while Conversion is on
extractionAudio.label: 14.4 / fw-regular color-gray-1, as the radio labels
extractionAudio.note: 12.8 / fw-regular color-gray-2-text below the row, like the new folder name hint

recordExport.menu: Export menu link after Archive, metrics menuLink, its entry dropdownItem; disabled without a DataForge and while a Record export runs
recordExport.setup: modal wide: groups Records (radio tree selection with name and count, radio Record path filter over a searchField), Form (radio JSON, radio NDJSON, radio flat CSV, radio flat CSV exact, radio flat NDJSON, then checkbox "Write the tag path next to every tag Reference", off by default, disabled for the flat forms), Target (as the Extraction setup); bodyGroupGap between groups
recordExport.cta: buttonCta Start export; Close is buttonGhost
recordExport.progress: non-modal modal frame, width 440: spinner while DataForge is read and Records are chosen, then progressBar with done of total; Cancel buttonGhost alone in the foot
recordExport.summary: non-modal modal frame, width 600: cancel note in color-warning, counts and target in color-gray-1, failed Records as collapsibleSection rows with the reason in color-danger-text; Close buttonCta alone in the foot; no target line when none was created

basetoolCatalog.menu: Two Export menu dropdownItems below Record export: normal Basetool catalog and explicit diagnostic Basetool catalog; disabled without a DataForge and while a catalog is created; system save dialog defaults to basetool-catalog.json.zst or basetool-catalog.diagnostic.json.zst; diagnostic permission applies to one job and is never persisted
basetoolCatalog.progress: non-modal modal frame, width 440: title explicitly names a diagnostic job; spinner while DataForge is read and while the file is written, progressBar with Records checked of total between; Cancel buttonGhost alone in the foot
basetoolCatalog.summary: non-modal modal frame, width 600: diagnostic title and color-warning notice for an explicit diagnostic export; source/projection health in color-gray-1 when complete or color-warning when incomplete; alertWarning near the upload limit or alertDanger over it; group labels Kinds (selection scope) and Texts with one color-gray-1 line per kind and language, then size in decimal units with the upload limit of 64 MB and the file; Close buttonCta alone in the foot
basetoolCatalog.cancelled: non-modal modal frame: note in color-warning, no file written
basetoolCatalog.failed: non-modal danger modal frame: the reason in color-danger-text; incomplete normal export creates or replaces no file and explains the separate diagnostic action; choosing the open Archive never writes it

factsBar.overflow: a value that does not fit is cut with an ellipsis; a fact with no room for its key and valueMinChars characters of its value is left out with every fact after it, and the bar ends in an ellipsis in color-gray-2-text
factsBar.direction: chevron right between old and new, chevron size 12, color-primary

kpiTile.label: changeChip of the change kind, as the chip in kpi-card

changeChip.dsClass: chip chip--success / chip--danger / chip--warning / chip--info / chip--muted

listTabs.position: between the summary and the list panel, only once the Record level was compared
listTabs.entryActions: the changeExtraction actions only while Entries is shown

recordTable.movedPath: old and new record path with the facts bar chevron-right (12, color-primary) between them, gap 8; read as old to new
recordTable.chips: changeChip: added, removed, moved, changed, unreadable

recordFields.panel: previewPanel below the Record list once a Record is selected, as lineDiff
recordFields.pathLine: previewPanel pathLine with the changeChip after the record path; the number of changes right in color-gray-2-text
recordFields.rows: tableRow with zebra and hover, without selection; focusable with focusRing offsetRow, the full text as tooltip on hover and focus
recordFields.keyboard: Tab focuses the field list; arrows, Page Up, Page Down, Home and End scroll
recordFields.messages: previewPanel body: added, removed, moved and equal in color-gray-1, unreadable sides and failures in color-danger-text

queryTable.header: tableHeader + sortIndicator; the record path head is a label in upper case, a select path stays as written
queryTable.errorValue: color-danger-text, also a list holding one
queryTable.nullValue: null in color-gray-2-text, sorted with missing values
queryTable.listCells: the values in brackets, the first 8 and then the number of more
queryTable.footer: listFooter with the number of Records left and the pagination right

queryCompletion.anchor: below the text cursor of the query editor, above it when there is no room

border.sides: all four, as it hangs on no field

queryCompletion.item: dropdownItem; the typed start in fw-bold (mark), the field type right in 12.8 color-gray-2-text
queryCompletion.keys: focus stays in the editor; ArrowUp/ArrowDown choose, Enter or Tab accepts, Escape closes, Ctrl+Space opens

savedQueries.keyboard: scrollRegion of D.27, name Saved Queries; the rows stay Tab targets
savedQueries.save: buttonGhost next to the run CTA
savedQueries.dialogs: modal for save and rename, modalDanger with buttonDanger for delete; note color-gray-2-text when it replaces, color-danger-text for a problem
savedQueries.empty: one sentence in color-gray-2-text under the header, no emptyState

lineDiff.panel: previewPanel below the change list once a change is selected, opening at half the remaining height (at least previewPanel minHeight), with resizeHandle; the selected row scrolls back into view
lineDiff.pathLine: previewPanel pathLine with the changeChip after the path
lineDiff.navigation: buttonCompact + buttonGhost, previous and next hunk, right in the path line
lineDiff.header: tableHeader with one cell per side, old left
lineDiff.keyboard: Tab focuses the lines; arrows, Page Up, Page Down, Home and End scroll
lineDiff.longLines: clipped per side, one horizontal scroll for both sides
lineDiff.messages: previewPanel body: binary and too large color-gray-1, failure color-danger-text

imagePreview.image: one texel per device pixel, centred, larger mips scroll
imagePreview.facts: factsBar without direction: format, size, mips, cubemap faces
imagePreview.selector: quickFilter, one item per mip labelled with its longer side
imagePreview.keyboard: Tab focuses the picture; arrows scroll by pictureKeyStep, Page Up, Page Down, Home and End scroll
imagePreview.messages: unsupported format, unshowable and failure color-danger-text

modelPreview.panelFollows: the Entry, not the tab: the panel of a model Entry has this height and minimum on every tab, so switching tabs does not move it
modelPreview.panelHeightFrom: tab bar 44 + path line 32 + facts bar 32 + view 160 + overlayGap 8 + playback bar 36 (rowHeight, the height of a checkbox cell) + panel chrome 37 (resize gap, frame padding and rules, as for the soundbank list); panelMinHeight 285 is the same with the view at viewMinHeight 96 instead of viewHeight 160, so the playback bar never overlaps the view
modelPreview.playbackBar: below the view, overlayGap under it, barHeight high: btn-outline btn-xs Play or Pause, the time in 12 / 400 color-gray-1, the position slider, then the checkboxes Loop and Skeleton; models with a skeleton and no animation show the Skeleton checkbox alone
modelPreview.animationList: right of the view, overlayGap apart, animationListWidth wide: the eyebrow Animations in color-gray-2-text over a scroll list of radios, the first for the bind pose, rowHeight each
modelPreview.skeletonOverlay: one boneStroke line per bone from its parent in color-primary, over the model without depth test
modelPreview.resetButton: btn-ghost btn-xs, top right inside the view, disabled while the view is framed
modelPreview.hint: right in the facts bar, 12.8 / 400 color-gray-2-text, cut with an ellipsis
modelPreview.mouse: drag orbits; secondary or middle drag or Shift drag pans; wheel and pinch zoom
modelPreview.keyboard: Tab focuses the view; arrows orbit, Shift and arrows pan, plus and minus zoom, Home resets
modelPreview.messages: no device, lost device, failure and unreadable model color-danger-text; too large, empty and too large for the device color-gray-1; archive changed color-warning

assemblyView.panelHeightFrom: facts bar 32 + view 280 + overlayGap 8 + barRows 2 x bar 36 (rowHeight) + panel chrome 37; the minimum has the view at modelPreview.viewMinHeight 96; where the window leaves less, the view gives way in height (at least 1 point) instead of the bar overlapping it, as in modelPreview
assemblyView.layout: in the Entities tab, right of the picker: the view panel on top, resizable at its lower edge between panelMinHeight and the height that leaves treeMinHeight to the Loadout tree, then the Loadout tree
assemblyView.bar: below the view, overlayGap under it, two rows of barHeight each: the controls row with the eyebrow Detail and a segmented control 0 to 3, the eyebrow Materials with a segmented control Colours and Textures, and the checkbox Interior (disabled for an Entity that names no object containers); under it the status row over the full width, right to left: a btn-ghost btn-xs Show all (n) while branches are hidden, then while building a btn-outline btn-xs Stop, the stage text in color-gray-1 and a spinner, else the issues, failure or stopped message
assemblyView.interior: the checkbox Interior builds the rooms and props of the object containers off the UI thread, with the progress in the bar and Stop, and draws them with the hull; switching it off hides them without building again, and the facts bar gains an Interior fact while they are shown; a new Loadout or level of detail builds the view with the Interior only while the checkbox is on
assemblyView.interiorExport: the export setup of an Entity has the group Interior with a checkbox, remembered with the other choices; the export of a socpak container on its own opens the same setup with the line Container: name instead of the Entity and Loadout lines, from the btn-ghost btn-xs Export Interior… beside Copy of the preview and from the Export menu, and shows the stage Reading the Interior with the model files read in the progress window
assemblyView.treeActions: btn-ghost btn-xs Hide or Show per port with an entity, before Replace; a hidden port gets the muted chip Hidden
assemblyView.culling: parts outside the view or under minPartPixels 0.75 projected radius are not drawn; parts sharing a mesh range and texture are one instanced draw call
assemblyView.messages: empty Loadout and stopped color-gray-1; archive changed color-warning; missing key and failure color-danger-text; graphics problems as modelPreview.messages

assemblyExportPackage.entitiesButton: btn-cta Export… in the Entities toolbar opens the export setup of the Entity
assemblyExportPackage.output: the group Output (GLB file, Blender package) as a segmented--sm control in one row with the level of detail, MODAL_GROUP_GAP between; with the package chosen the hint in color-gray-2-text FS_XS under the row, the Materials group is hidden and the group File becomes Package folder
assemblyExportPackage.folder: the chosen folder is the package; new, empty or an earlier package of P4KX; an earlier package is named in color-warning and replaced as a whole once the new one is complete; anything else, a path without a folder name and an installation are a danger-alert and disable Export
assemblyExportPackage.progress: stage Writing shows the text without a byte count and Cancel; the summary Blender package written lists folder, counts, Interior, textures not written and the issues
assemblyExportPackage.scope: an Entity, an Interior container on its own (D.54) and the Character of the Characters tab (D.54)
assemblyExportPackage.character: D.54: btn-cta Export… in the Characters toolbar opens the modal Export Character with the group Output, the hint in color-gray-2-text FS_XS beside the group Animations (None, All; All by default; no picker of named clips, no --anim-from), starting on the GLB file whatever the Entity export chose, the group File or Package folder, the notices of the Entity and the foot Export and Close; detail and materials stay in the toolbar
assemblyExportPackage.messages: replaces color-warning; not a package, no folder name and installation color-gray-1 in a danger-alert

entityReplace.listHeightFrom: previewPanel.defaultHeight; the list scrolls inside the room the modal has between the header and the status bar
entityReplace.headGapFrom: modal.bodyGroupGap / 2, between the line of what the port takes and the search field

entityVariants.rule: the groups of ADR-0066 (variantOf), read from the Records without a catalog build; a variant is listed under its base only while its base is listed by the kind filter
entityVariants.base: the list row of the Entity with, at the tree level 0 chevron cell, the primary chevron that lists or folds the variants, and at the right edge a muted chip with the number of variants (one Variant, n Variants)
entityVariants.variant: a list row at tree level 1 with the rail of the tree, selectable like any Entity
entityVariants.keyboard: the chevron is a button in the tab order named Show the variants of or Hide the variants of the class name; Enter and Space list or fold
entityVariants.search: a base is listed when it or one of its variants matches, with the matching variants listed below it; a search opens such a group, the chevron folds it by hand until the search text changes
entityVariants.footer: counts the Entities that match, those folded under a base included

characterBuilder.dsClass: previewPanel + facts-bar + segmented--sm + btn-ghost btn-xs + btn-outline btn-xs
characterBuilder.reportHeightFrom: head row + reportRows rows of rowHeight 36
characterBuilder.layout: tab Characters after Sounds: a toolbar like the Entities toolbar on top, left a resizable choices panel between sidebarMinWidth and sidebarMaxWidth, right the facts bar, the status line, the 3D view with the playback bar of modelPreview and below it the report; the work surface is never narrower than workSurface.minWidth (D.52), so there is no stacked layout (D.55)
characterBuilder.toolbar: the eyebrow Detail with a segmented--sm control 0 to 3, the eyebrow Materials with a segmented--sm control Colours and Textures, right a btn-cta Export… that opens the export setup (D.54)
characterBuilder.choices: eyebrow groups Body (segmented--sm Male and Female, locked while a head is chosen), Head (line, btn-outline btn-xs from the Archive and from a file, btn-ghost btn-xs Remove), Armour and clothing (Loadout line with Choose and Remove, pieces as rows with a close icon, btn-outline btn-xs Add), Expressions (checkbox, radio list of expressionRows rows that scrolls, slider Strength)
characterBuilder.report: head row with the count of pieces left out or noted, rows Left out in color-warning and Note in color-gray-1, a row for each piece of the Loadout another piece replaced; with none the line Every piece fits in color-gray-1
characterBuilder.messages: building as assemblyView.bar; stopped and empty color-gray-1; archive changed color-warning; missing key, CHF and failure color-danger-text; graphics problems as modelPreview.messages

slider.keys: ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, PageUp, PageDown, Home, End

audioPreview.dsClass: previewPanel + facts-bar + btn btn-outline btn-xs + slider
audioPreview.timeWidth: the widest time of the sound
audioPreview.facts: factsBar without direction: codec, channels, sample rate, duration
audioPreview.toggle: outline btn-xs, play or pause; Space while no other control has the focus
audioPreview.pauses: when the preview tab leaves Audio or the work tab leaves Browse
audioPreview.messages: unsupported codec, too long, decoding and output failure color-danger-text

soundbankList.panelHeightFrom: tab bar 44 + path line 32 + facts bar 32 + controls 16 + 32 + head 36 + 4 rows of 36 + panel chrome 37 (resize gap, frame padding and rules, measured)
soundbankList.columnsFrom: widest text in bold at the row font plus the cell padding twice, rounded up: ID of ten digits 105.4, Wwise Vorbis 110.6, 9:59:59.999 99.9
soundbankList.head: tableHead without sorting
soundbankList.order: path line, then the audioPreview of the selected WEM, then the list filling the rest
soundbankList.prefetched: codec cell Prefetched in color-gray-2-text; the controls give way to a color-warning note
soundbankList.pluginMedia: codec cell Plug-in in color-gray-2-text; the controls give way to a color-warning note
soundbankList.row: tableRow with the active bar; accessible name WEM id, codec, duration
soundbankList.keys: Tab focuses the rows and the list; Enter or a click selects; arrows, Page Up, Page Down, Home and End scroll
soundbankList.messages: unreadable bank color-danger-text, empty bank plain text

soundTables.columnsFrom: name: the sample name of forty characters Play_SC_Ship_Weapon_Ballistic_Fire_Heavy, 293.0, longer names clip; state: the longest status or head of the trigger table in German or British English, 131.4; language: the default language English(US) with the fallback mark in German or British English, 155.0; language folder names are Archive data, so other names may clip and the column is resizable; each in bold at the row font plus the cell padding twice, rounded up
soundTables.dividers: the column dividers of the trigger table end above the list footer, like the tag tree
soundTables.languagePicker: a wrapping row between the Entity actions and the search field, shown only while the Archive holds more than one language folder: the eyebrow label, then one btn-xs per language, the chosen one in the selected colours of the controls (control-selected-bg, control-selected-border, control-selected-fg) and exposed as selected, the others btn-ghost; btn-outline stays the primary action

xmlPreview.keyboard: Tab focuses the lines; arrows, Page Up, Page Down, Home and End scroll
xmlPreview.longLines: cut after 1024 characters with an ellipsis, one horizontal scroll
xmlPreview.truncated: note in color-warning above the lines, like the truncated Text tab
xmlPreview.messages: converting with the inline spinner, too large color-gray-1, failure color-danger-text

recordPreview.columns: two equal columns, field and value
recordPreview.pathLine: record path color-gray-1, Record name color-gray-2-text
recordPreview.facts: factsBar without direction: type, GUID, name
recordPreview.link: 12.8 / fw-bold color-primary, hover color-accent-light with underline, target type after 8 in color-gray-2-text
recordPreview.danglingLink: error text in color-danger-text, underlined on hover
recordPreview.navigation: Back and Forward as ghost btn-xs left of Copy; Alt+Left, Alt+Right, mouse back and forward
recordPreview.keyboard: Tab focuses the field lines; arrows, Page Up, Page Down, Home and End scroll

keyText.menu: Record texts menu link after Export, metrics menuLink; entries dropdownItem with radio, Keys only first, then the languages the Archive holds; disabled without a global.ini
keyText.key: color-gray-2-text while a text or the mark follows, else color-gray-1
keyText.text: after the key 8, 13.76 / fw-regular color-gray-1, cut with an ellipsis; control, bidirectional and line feed characters as escapes
keyText.missing: chip--warning, label Missing, after the key 8
keyText.placeholder: placeholder and empty keys stay alone
